exposure: antigen specific antibody levels (OMP, GroEL, NapA)
outcome: two or more adverse pregnancy outcomes
cohort: The study included 1372 pregnant women from three European birth cohorts: BiB (United Kingdom), Rhea (Greece), and INMA (Spain).
finding: Helicobacter pylori seropositivity was associated with multiple adverse pregnancy outcomes, especially hypertensive disorders in women of western ethnicity, and specific antibody responses to OMP, GroEL, and NapA antigens further determined these disease associations.
